name: Jarvis 32.0
notes: New Low Performance SSR report: type "Show me 5 low performance SSR by ASM wise", "…by TL wise", "SSR achievement under or equal 7 by ASM wise" or "SSR achievement % below 30 by TL wise" – lowest / top N under each ASM, TL or ASM then TL, any number or % limit, with charts for each ASM / TL. Works without ASM / TL too ("Top 10 SSR by achievement"). Employees marked Left in a Working Status column are no longer counted in employee reports, Performance Ranking or Target vs Achievement (Settings → Working Status, or type "including left"). New 🔻 Low performers button on the Targets page. Columns spelt "Acheivement" / "Pecentage" are now read.
